copy.headline: Iconic toy retailer Toys 'R' Us opens only standalone store in Fort Worth
copy.caption: Beloved toy store Toys "R" Us, the chain that sells toys, games, electronics, and gear, has debuted in Fort Worth in time for 2026 holiday shopping. According to a release, a Toys "R" Us store has opened at Tanger Outlets Fort Worth, 15853 N Fwy., Ste. 1140, in far north Fort Worth.
